title: The Conquest of the Land
english: [...], the sand of the sea, and he set himself against Jesus. But Jesus, falling upon them suddenly, slaughtered him and all his allies with all the force of an army, and he cut down their horses, and he divided all their land among the Israelites.

To the tribe of Reuben he allotted the land of the Amorites and the Rapha; and to Gad the same land of the Amorites, and he divided half to the tribe of Manasseh; and to the tribe of Judah the [land] of the Hebrews, and of the Hittites, and of the Anakim.
For Judah, a tribe having taken the tribe of Simeon as an ally, drove out the Canaanites and the Perizzites, and seizing the fleeing Adoni-Bezek, they maimed his feet and his hands; and [...]

title: The Death of Joshua and Tribal Inheritances
english: Self-condemning, he said, "Just as I have done, so God has repaid me. For seventy kings, their extremities of feet and hands having been cut off, were lying beneath my table, recounting the fallen ones." Having been brought into Jerusalem, he died immediately.

And Jesus caused to perish the land of Ephraim, belonging to the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Samaritans; and the land of Manasseh, half a tribe, belonging to the Geshurites and the Amorites. But he bequeathed the land of the Hebrews, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites, to Benjamin; and to Simeon, that of the Hebrews and the Perizzites; and to Zebulun, that of the Perizzites; and to the Kenites [...]

title: Tribal Allotments and the Apostasy
english: Naphtali; and for the tribe of Dan, the Amorites; and the tribe of Issachar; and for the tribe of Asher, the Perizzites (Joshua 19:25-26). Having distributed all this land, Jesus, having lived seventy and ten years, died (Joshua 24:20). And after the death of Eleazar the son of Aaron, Phinehas his son took up the high priesthood (Numbers 20:28).

But after the death of Joshua, the Israelites, having turned away from God, worshipped Astarte (Judges 2:11), and God delivered them into the hands of Cusharthan the Syrian king, who put them into much distress, so that, having been much afflicted, they cried out to God, and judges were given to them (Judges 2:11-16).
